name: genesis
vibe: the flagship LIVING WORLD film — instead of text on cards, a whole cinematic world lives behind the story: a deep night skyline of glass towers with lit windows, a brand-colored sun casting god-rays through atmospheric fog, birds crossing in formation and people walking the streets, all under a slow camera push. Eight movie-trailer beats play over it — a world intro, the old chaos, order emerging, an epic product reveal in a floating screenshot showroom, feature mini-worlds, a loved-worldwide crowd with counting metrics, a growth graph drawn into the city, and a logo climax. Built for the most impressive launch, brand and product films — a premium commercial, not a slideshow. Fully brand-adaptive: one hue repaints the whole world.
